development_dataset.target: Visibly rendered live in-game character, either team; box visible body pixels only.
development_dataset.annotation_method: Single-pass visual boxing by Codex before viewing predictions; coordinates estimated from enlarged frame crops. Human review pending.
development_dataset.split_method: Temporal blocks from one round; development f007–f032, test f000–f003 and f034–f054. Skip guard f004–f006 and f033 and post-game player camera f055–f067.

prediction_metadata.latency_definition: Warm per-frame CPU wall time at input candidate threshold 0.01, excluding load and decode. I3 adds measured rescoring to I2. I4 adds measured tile inference and agreement to I3.

configuration.description: Proposal gameplay ROI and hard geometry rules
Proposal ROI at larger input size
I2 with a score boost for small predicted boxes
I3 with a larger score boost when a tile confirms the box

holdout_dataset.scope: Living visible CS2 character from either team, in independent recordings cut from spectated game replays.
holdout_dataset.annotation_method: Codex visually annotated body bounding boxes from frame crops without viewing detector outputs. Independent human review pending.
holdout_dataset.split_method: One frozen holdout across six Dust II clips and one Nuke clip taken from three local replay matches. Candidate timestamps were generated at 2 Hz. The subset was chosen by raw clip inspection for visible players, backgrounds, and gameplay variation. Near-duplicate Nuke clip h06 was excluded before evaluation.
holdout_dataset.target: One tight box around the rendered visible body of each living character from either team. Exclude first-person hands/weapons, HUD, purely x-ray geometry, and recognizable corpses/ragdolls.

prediction_metadata.latency_definition: Warm per-frame CPU wall time at input candidate threshold 0.01, excluding load and decode. I3 adds measured rescoring to I2. I4 adds measured tile inference and agreement to I3.
